svg.title: Agentic harness architecture: the loop, the context window, the tools and the delegation layer
svg.text: The model is one box. Everything around it is the harness, and that is where the behaviour comes from.
one line, body read on use
a prompt, or the result of the previous tools
stable prefix first, then the volatile tail
the cache boundary sits exactly between the two
one call per turn, prefix cache reused
the harness never edits what the model wrote
the single branch that drives the whole loop
an error is a normal result, not a crash
triggered by budget, never by turn count
a fresh window that burns its own tokens
streamed to the terminal, loop exits
what must always happen is not a prompt
